project: ALSKwela A&E 2027 — JHS LS3 Mathematical and Problem-Solving Skills
source: Uploaded DepEd Bureau of Alternative Education Revised ALS Curriculum Guide for A&E JHS LS3 (57 pages)
review_note: Independent practice questions based on uploaded curriculum; not official BEA test items or a validated 2027 prediction. Mathematical SME review, learner piloting, and item analysis required.

items.stimulus: Daily temperatures (°C) for a week are 26, 27, 29, 30, 28, 27, and 31.
items.question: What is the range?
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Na-apply mo nang wasto ang math concept.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Balikan natin ang given values at ang tamang formula.
items.explanation: Range ay maximum minus minimum: 31−26=5°C.
items.review_status: Draft – mathematical content review and pilot testing required

items.stimulus: Simplify (6x²)/(3x), where x ≠ 0.
items.question: Which answer is correct?
items.feedback_correct: Great work! Naipakita mo ang tamang pag-unawa sa problem.
items.feedback_incorrect: Keep practicing! Makakatulong ang step-by-step explanation sa susunod.
items.explanation: I-divide ang coefficients 6/3=2 at bawasan ang exponents ng x: x²/x=x. Sagot 2x.
